label: preparing
what: A coordinated acquisition of grain/hay and related private bread-supply arrangements: builder and freight sought nineteen bales, offering planks/services; the innkeeper also sought grain and discussed credit or trade. Builder was observed giving planks to baker, and reports place baker, innkeeper, and freight together at the bakery. This appears to be practical supply/trade coordination, not a confirmed bridge or port alteration. Secretary knowingly handles scheduling, but there is no evidence of involvement in the trade itself; neighbour is an information source, not a confirmed collaborator.
